blind.B2: C2-/- vs WT single EDL fibres, young male; paper says n=10 per group (S3.5.p1), GEO has 27 WT / 20 KO fibres from 3 WT and 2 KO mice (extract_protocol).
blind.B3: Yes: several fibres per mouse (3 WT, 2 KO mice). No animal-ID field in metadata; candidate-key table is empty. Title suffixes (s2445-x, s740-x) hint at donor mice for KO only.
blind.B4: Paper does not say (only limma/voom, S2.11.p1).
blind.B5: S2.11.p1: 'genes surpassing the defined moderate threshold criteria (|fold| > 1.5x and (adjusted) p < 0.05) were designated as differentially expressed'; limma/voom after edgeR TMM. FIG8 legend (per packet B) says log fold-change cutoff 0.5. Reports 956 DEGs (621 up/335 down) (S3.5.p1).
